# lebop v0.0.8

## Changes

- Upgrade `@linear/sdk` from 91.0.0 to 95.0.0.
- Remove `cycle create` / `create_cycle`. Linear's live API refuses
  `cycleCreate` ("Cycle creation is not supported."); cycles come from team
  settings. Keep list/view/update/archive and issue assignment via `set cycle`
  / `update_issue`. Live proofs use an existing team cycle and do not archive
  shared team cycles.

## Verification

- Full test suite, typecheck, package validation, and static checks passed.
- Full live CLI and MCP playground-sandbox validation completed with no failed steps.
- Discovery and adversary live smokes passed.
- All resources created during live validation were verified cleaned up.
